headline: ‘It’s Like Falling in Love’: Israeli Entrepreneurs Welcomed in Dubai
snippet: A high-profile delegation of Israeli innovators visited the United Arab Emirates soon after moves to normalize relations.

headline: Kisner Leads by 2 in China
snippet: Kevin Kisner kept up his impressive debut in China with a six-under-par 66 that gave him a two-shot lead over Russell Knox at the HSBC Champions in Shanghai.

headline: A CONVERSATION WITH: ANNE FOERST; Do Androids Dream? M.I.T. Working on It
snippet: Interview with Dr Anne Foerst, researcher at Artificial Ingelligence Laboratory at Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and director of MIT's God and Computers project; Foerst, a Lutheran minister, says laboratory is trying to build robots that are social and embodied; photos (L)
